name: evs08
_comment: JODELL EVS08 vacuum gripper with 4 custom 1.5-bellows cups (24 mm lip, 23 mm bellows + 6 mm hex fitting), as fitted on the Agibot G2. Measured on the robot: flange -> uncompressed cup lip 128 mm, 49.5 mm cup square; head shape from a head-camera scan (3 boxes: EVS08 body, hand camera on +y, wrist adapter), the body stopping at the EVS08 face 99 mm from the flange. Tool frame = flange axes, origin at the lip plane centre, +z = approach. All shapes are in the tool frame (flange z - 0.128).
_robot_mounting: used by the G2 example only (g2_reach.py): flange (arm_r_end_link) -> tool
_placeholders: body face at 99 mm (from the cup stack; the scan's box reached 120 mm)
